summary: Backend API testing completed for me&you (French adult content creator platform). All 32 tests passed after fixing 1 bug. Auth, Creators, Payments, Verification, and Messaging endpoints all working correctly.

fixed.issue: MongoDB _id was not being removed from user_doc after insert_one, causing 500 Internal Server Error
fixed.fix: Added user_doc.pop('_id', None) before returning response

critical_code_review_comments: Registration endpoint was missing _id removal after MongoDB insert - FIXED
Brute force protection works but uses IP+email identifier which may not trigger in all test environments
Stripe Identity falls back to mock mode correctly when API key doesn't support Identity product
All endpoints properly exclude MongoDB _id from responses
seed_data_creation: 6 seeded creators with 3 content items each (1 free, 2 premium, 1 with unlock_price=3.99)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend APIs tested and working. Registration bug was fixed (MongoDB _id leakage). Stripe Identity uses mock mode with sk_test_emergent key. Payment checkout URLs are generated correctly via emergentintegrations library. Brute force protection is implemented but may not trigger in test environment due to IP-based tracking.
